value.text:
The `memopayload.NewRunner` and `RunOnce` methods don't appear to be used in production code paths, likely only invoked in tests or admin scripts. Looking at the actual question though—which concrete implementation of the markdown processing interface runs at runtime, who creates it, and which components hold the interface—the answer is that `*service` in the internal package is the only concrete implementation being used.

The service gets instantiated via `markdown.NewService(...)` at the API v1 router initialization, and that single instance is stored in `APIV1Service.MarkdownService`, then distributed down to `RSSService` and `memopayload.Runner`, plus passed directly to `RebuildMemoPayload`. Now I should check the test helpers and RSS implementation to see if there are any mock implementations of the Service interface elsewhere.

There's only one concrete implementation of the markdown service in the codebase, and it's used by three main holders: the API service, RSS service, and memo payload runner, though the function parameter in RebuildMemoPayload is more of a transient reference than a persistent holder.

**Interface:** `Service` defined in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-55` (methods `ExtractAll`, `ExtractTags`, `ExtractProperties`, `RenderMarkdown`, `RenderHTML`, `GenerateSnippet`, `ValidateContent`, `RenameTag`).

**Concrete implementation executed at runtime:** the single unexported struct `*service` (goldmark-backed) defined at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:57-60`, which wraps a `goldmark.Markdown` (`github.com/yuin/goldmark`) with the custom `extensions.TagExtension` / `extensions.MentionExtension` (`internal/markdown/extensions/tag.go`, `internal/markdown/extensions/mention.go`) and the custom AST-to-markdown `renderer.NewMarkdownRenderer()` (`internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go`). This is the only type in the codebase satisfying `Service`.

**Construction:** exclusively via the factory function `markdown.NewService(opts ...Option)` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:85-113`), called with `markdown.WithTagExtension()` and `markdown.WithMentionExtension()`:
- Production: inside `NewAPIV1Service` at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:47-51` — this is the one instance created for the running server.
- Tests: inside `NewTestService` at `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44-47` (a separate instance for test wiring).

**Holders of the `markdown.Service` interface field/parameter** (all typed as the interface, never the concrete struct):
- `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35` (the primary holder; the instance built in `NewAPIV1Service` is stored here and reused by `memo_service.go` and `memo_mention_helpers.go`).
- `RSSService.MarkdownService` — `server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, populated by passing `apiV1Service.MarkdownService` into `rss.NewRSSService(...)` in `server/server.go:85`.
- `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:14-24` (constructed via its own `NewRunner`, though this runner isn't currently wired up/called from `server/server.go` or `cmd`).
- The package-level function `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(_, memo, markdownService markdown.Service)` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`) also takes the interface as a parameter and is invoked directly with `s.MarkdownService` from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` and `:447`.
